citeAs: Bizon C, Cox S, Balhoff J, Kebede Y, Wang P, Morton K, Fecho K, Tropsha A. ROBOKOP KG and KGB: integrated knowledge graphs from federated sources. J Chem Inf Model 2019 Dec 23;59(12):4968–4973. doi: 10.1021/acs.jcim.9b00683. https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/31769676/.
conditionsOfAccess: The ROBOKOP website (‘ROBOKOP’) has been designed to provide you with access to biomedical exploration and inference tools developed by RENCI and CoVar LLC (hereafter referred to as the ‘ROBOKOP team’). The ROBOKOP team authorizes you to access and use ROBOKOP under the conditions set forth below.
dct:provenance: No GitHub or other public repository content was read or used to generate this metadata. The complete 23-graph/23-version/228-asset inventory was discovered from the configured ROBOKOP source. Frontend same-origin per-file URLs returned HTTP 404; official STARS mappings were confirmed by successful file responses. The advertised inventory totals 168241010361 bytes (156.687 GiB). The bounded local transfer completed 112 graph assets totaling 224600510 bytes and retained 905969664 partial bytes because a full transfer would take several hours. All 228 assets remain represented with distinct verified official STARS URLs. Datatype and schema samples used at most five records per represented repeating structure and preserve exact JSON property names and JSONPath selectors without normalization. .gz assets are compressed single files, not archives; no archive members were inferred. All 92 target repeating structures were sampled; there were no unresolved target schema samples. 7 sampled fields with null-only, object, complex-list, or heterogeneous values use conservative text typing; this bounded-sample ambiguity is not a claim about unsampled values. RecordSets were not generated for metadata, schema, Neo4j dump, or Cypher assets because bounded inspection did not demonstrate a reliable repeating record location for those files. No GeoCoordinates parent was added because the sampled source fields did not support a coherent geographic-column grouping. During structural validation, the original 228 per-file FileObjects were consolidated into 23 authoritative release-directory FileSets because ROBOKOP does not publish MD5 or SHA-256 values and Croissant FileObject requires one of those checksums. Each FileSet includes every exact advertised member filename and every field source now identifies both the release FileSet and exact member path; no file was dropped from the represented 228-member inventory. Relaxed geographic-name review found one field named `location` in the HGNC node records; source context establishes it as a genomic/chromosomal locus rather than a geographic place, so no GeoCoordinates hierarchy was added.
description: ROBOKOP is an open-source biomedical knowledge graph that integrates and semantically harmonizes important knowledge sources.
